field.acOnly: Keep awake only on AC power
hint.language: Changes apply the next time the app launches.
hint.processList: Comma-separated executable names, e.g. ollama, docker, node.
hint.safety: Governors can only allow sleep — they never keep the Mac awake against these limits.
about.tagline: Keeps your Mac awake only while real agent work is happening.
about.privilege: Lumen installs a small root LaunchDaemon once, using a single macOS administrator prompt. Day-to-day controls need no password.
reason.waiting: Waiting for the daemon to report…
reason.notInstalled: Open Settings › About to install the daemon.
install.firstRunPrompt: Lumen needs to install a small background daemon to manage sleep. macOS will ask for your administrator password once.
install.reinstallPrompt: Reinstall or update the Lumen background daemon? macOS will ask for your administrator password once.
alert.installed: The Lumen daemon was installed and started.
alert.failed: The operation could not be completed.
